record.question: The codes for external causes ________ should be used as the primary codes for single-condition coding and tabulation of mortality involving injury, poisoning and certain other consequences of external causes.
record.explanation: Official final key: A — V01-Y89. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 5, printed Q58. The selected code range is V01–Y89. The printed assertion about primary coding needs to be interpreted in the relevant mortality-coding framework rather than generalized to all clinical coding.
